title: [nightly/feature] Download every round as a CSV file from Settings
summary: Settings gets a Your rounds card with Download CSV: every saved round, newest first, with date, course, tee, score, to-par, nines, putts, greens, fairways and each hole's score, using the same figures the app shows. Golfers can back up their rounds or take them to a spreadsheet.
